shared.auth.accountExists.defaultMessage: An account with that email already exists. Sign in with it, then connect this account from the account page.
shared.auth.accountExists.description: The error of a GitHub or Google sign-in whose email belongs to another account of the app.

shared.auth.accountInactive.description: The error of a sign-in with an account that an admin turned off.

shared.auth.authenticatorCode.description: The label of the authenticator code field of the second step.

shared.auth.backToSignIn.description: The link back to the sign-in page.

shared.auth.cancel.description: The button that closes the dialog of the second step.

shared.auth.codeRejected.defaultMessage: That code was not accepted. Please try again.
shared.auth.codeRejected.description: The error of a second-step code that the gateway refused without a reason.

shared.auth.confirmIdentity.description: The title of the second step of a sign-in.

shared.auth.confirmPassword.description: The label of the field that repeats the new password.

shared.auth.continue.description: The button or the link that goes to the next step after a success.

shared.auth.continueWith.description: The button that signs in with a provider. The provider is a name, such as GitHub.

shared.auth.createAccount.description: The button that registers a new account.

shared.auth.createOne.description: The link to the register page, after "Don't have an account?".

shared.auth.email.description: The label of the email field of an auth form.

shared.auth.emailUnverified.defaultMessage: That account has no verified email. Verify it with the provider first.
shared.auth.emailUnverified.description: The error of a GitHub or Google sign-in with an account whose email is not verified.

shared.auth.expired.defaultMessage: Too many wrong tries. Please sign in again.
shared.auth.expired.description: The notice after the gateway ended a session for too many wrong second-step tries.

shared.auth.forgotIntro.defaultMessage: Type the email of your account. We will send you a link to set a new password.
shared.auth.forgotIntro.description: The text of the page that sends a link to reset the password.

shared.auth.forgotPassword.description: The link to the page that sends a link to reset the password.

shared.auth.forgotSent.defaultMessage: If an account has that email, we sent it a link. The link works for one hour.
shared.auth.forgotSent.description: The notice after the page sent a link to reset the password.

shared.auth.forgotTitle.description: The title of the page that sends a link to reset the password.

shared.auth.fullName.description: The label of the name field of the register page.

shared.auth.getNewLink.description: The link to get a new reset link, after "Link expired?".

shared.auth.haveAccount.description: The text before the link to the sign-in page.

shared.auth.linkExpired.description: The text before the link to get a new reset link.

shared.auth.loginFailed.defaultMessage: Login failed. Please check your credentials and try again.
shared.auth.loginFailed.description: The error of a sign-in that the gateway refused without a reason.

shared.auth.loginTitle.description: The title of the sign-in page.

shared.auth.newPassword.description: The label of the new password field.

shared.auth.noAccount.description: The text before the link to the register page.

shared.auth.oauthFailed.defaultMessage: That sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
shared.auth.oauthFailed.description: The error of a GitHub or Google sign-in that did not complete.

shared.auth.oauthUnavailable.defaultMessage: That sign-in method is not available.
shared.auth.oauthUnavailable.description: The error of a GitHub or Google sign-in that the gateway does not offer.

shared.auth.passkeyCheckFailed.defaultMessage: The passkey check did not complete. Please try again.
shared.auth.passkeyCheckFailed.description: The error of a passkey second step that the reader or the browser stopped.

shared.auth.passkeySignInFailed.defaultMessage: Passkey sign-in did not complete. Please try again.
shared.auth.passkeySignInFailed.description: The error of a passkey sign-in that the reader or the browser stopped.

shared.auth.password.description: The label of the password field of an auth form.

shared.auth.passwordSet.defaultMessage: Your password is set. Please sign in.
shared.auth.passwordSet.description: The notice on the sign-in page after a password reset.

shared.auth.recoveryCode.description: The label of the recovery code field of the second step.

shared.auth.registerTitle.description: The title of the register page.

shared.auth.registered.defaultMessage: Check your email to finish signing up, then sign in.
shared.auth.registered.description: The notice on the sign-in page after a registration.

shared.auth.registrationFailed.defaultMessage: Registration failed. Please check your details and try again.
shared.auth.registrationFailed.description: The error of a registration that the gateway refused without a reason.

shared.auth.requestFailed.defaultMessage: The request failed. Please try again.
shared.auth.requestFailed.description: The error of a request for a reset link that the gateway refused without a reason.

shared.auth.resetFailed.defaultMessage: The password did not change. Please try again.
shared.auth.resetFailed.description: The error of a password reset that the gateway refused without a reason.

shared.auth.resetTitle.description: The title of the page that sets a new password from a reset link.

shared.auth.sendAnotherLink.description: The button that sends the link to reset the password again.

shared.auth.sendLink.description: The button that sends a link to reset the password.

shared.auth.setPassword.description: The button that sets the new password.

shared.auth.signIn.description: The button that signs in, and the link to the sign-in page.

shared.auth.signInWithPasskey.description: The button that signs in with a passkey.

shared.auth.signOut.description: The menu item and the button that end the session.

shared.auth.unexpected.defaultMessage: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
shared.auth.unexpected.description: The error of an auth request that fails, such as on a network failure.

shared.auth.useAuthenticator.description: The button that switches the second step to an authenticator code.

shared.auth.usePasskey.description: The button that gives the second step with a passkey.

shared.auth.useRecoveryCode.description: The button that switches the second step to a recovery code.

shared.auth.verified.description: The notice after the page verified the email.

shared.auth.verifyEmail.description: The button that verifies the email from the link.

shared.auth.verifyFailed.defaultMessage: The email was not verified. Please try again.
shared.auth.verifyFailed.description: The error of an email verification that the gateway refused without a reason.

shared.auth.verifyMenu.description: The user menu item that sends a link to verify the email.

shared.auth.verifyMenuFailed.defaultMessage: Link not sent, try again later
shared.auth.verifyMenuFailed.description: The user menu item after the link to verify the email did not send.

shared.auth.verifyMenuSent.description: The user menu item after it sent the link to verify the email.

shared.auth.verifyTitle.description: The title of the page that verifies an email from a link.

shared.error.body.defaultMessage: The page could not load. Try again soon.
shared.error.body.description: The text under the title of the page that shows when a page fails.

shared.error.retry.description: The button that loads a failed page again.

shared.error.title.description: The title of the page that shows when a page fails.

shared.notFound.body.defaultMessage: This page could not be found
shared.notFound.body.description: The text under the 404 of the page of a path that has no route.

shared.validation.email.defaultMessage: Please enter a valid email address
shared.validation.email.description: The error of an email field that does not hold an email address.

shared.validation.minLength.defaultMessage: {min, plural, one {Must be at least # character} other {Must be at least # characters}}
shared.validation.minLength.description: The error of a field that is too short. The min is the shortest length.

shared.validation.passwordMismatch.description: The error of the field that repeats the password, when the two differ.

shared.validation.required.description: The error of a form field that the reader left empty.
